newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Integrated Living started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Integrated Living started.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown analyst Jean Swenson said she started Integrated Living Communities Inc as a buy and set a 12-month price target of $13 on the stock.
-- Swenson said expects the company to produce earnings of $0.10 per share during the 1996 year, lose $0.50 per share in 1997 and return to profitability with $0.90 per share in earnings during 1998.
-- She noted that losses during 1997 stem from the company's agressive plans to develop 24 new facilities in the upcoming year compared with no new facilities in 1996.
-- The company was spun off by Integrated Health Services Inc earlier this year.
-- The analyst said she maintains buy ratings on two other assisted living facilites providers: Sunrise Assisted Living Inc and Atria Communities Inc.
-- Integrated Living stood at 6, down 1/8 of a point shortly after the opening of trading Monday.
